programme.title: The Great Celebrity Bake Off
programme.desc: An exciting show in which stars try to impress the strict judges Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith with their culinary skills.Famous personalities such as David Schwimmer from "Friends", Paddy McGuinness from "Top Gear" and Deborah Meaden from "Dragon's Den" meet in the iconic "Bake Off" tent.Participants take on the confectionery challenge.The competition is accompanied by a noble goal - promoting cancer prevention.During subsequent competitions, emotions grow and the stars fight for the recognition of the expert jury and support for an important social initiative In the Christmas edition of the culinary show, celebrities face the task of delighting the jurors with their confectionery ideas and skills.At stake is not only the title of the best, but also the winnings, which the winners donate to support selected charitable causes.In this version of the program, actor James McAvoy, singer Anne-Marie, comedian David Baddiel and Olympic champion Kelly Holmes take part, competing with each other for the title of Christmas baking champion and helping those in need.
